prompt:
Create a matching pixel-art animation atlas of ONLY RENE LE CHEVALIER, the RIGHT-HAND commentator in the supplied reference images. Reference1 provides his neutral seated down-rink pose, reference2 his mild LEFTWARD head turn toward Gerard. Preserve exact costume, face, silvery hair, small grey moustache, black rectangular glasses, dark blue headphones/microphone, blue blazer and navy tie, hands clasped on desk. Flat broad color clusters in the same simplified v35 style, NOT more detailed. Small mature eyes, subdued white sclera under lids, dark pupils looking down at rink for neutral poses or LEFT toward partner for turned poses. Same identity, no Gerard in output.
One sheet exactly TWO COLUMNS by FOUR ROWS, 8 equal frames of aspect3:2 EACH. Full sheet768x1024 (each384x256) or proportional. Identical fixed camera, scale and desk position in every cell. Chest-up seated figure fits into each cell with shoulder margins, dark #081522 background, fixed blue desk along bottom at94%height. NO labels, NO text, NO gutters. Designed for nearest-neighbor reduction to192x128 per cell.
ROW-MAJOR POSES:
1 neutral face facing mostly forward with lowered chin, gaze DOWN at rink, mouth CLOSED under moustache.
2 EXACT same body/head/hair/eyes as1, only lower mouth opens a little for a short speaking syllable.
3 EXACT same as1, only mouth makes a small open O for another syllable, no grinning or huge mouth.
4 EXACT same as1, mouth CLOSED and one quiet blink, both eyes closed.
5 head turns mildly LEFT toward Gerard (15-20 degrees, not profile, chin NOT lifted toward standing figure); mouth CLOSED, eyes left. Torso and hands still exactly1.
6 EXACTLY pose5 head/torso/hair/eyes, only mouth opens to speak a calm analytical syllable; keep moustache fixed.
7 EXACTLY pose5, only small rounded speaking O mouth.
8 intermediate head pose halfway between1 and5, eyes already moving left, mouth closed. Subtle attentive turn, head not cocked or raised.
Hard pixel edges, 4 warm skin color clusters. No blue in eyes/moustache, no wrinkles dotted across skin, no random facial details. Prioritize exact identical character registration between mouth poses. Hands, shoulders, hair and glasses do not move when speaking.
